plan.subject: Understand the foundational concepts of machine learning and its relevance to real-world applications.
plan.objective: Understand the foundational concepts of machine learning and its relevance to real-world applications.

blocks.title: Mathematical Foundation
blocks.teachingObjective: Machine learning relies on mathematical tools to model and analyze data.

blocks.title: What is Machine Learning?
blocks.teachingObjective: Understanding the definition is essential to grasp the scope and purpose of ML.
examples: A system that learns from data without explicit programming

blocks.title: Big Picture of ML
blocks.teachingObjective: This provides a framework to understand how ML systems operate and make decisions.
examples: Taking picking fruits as an example to illustrate learning from data

blocks.title: Why ML?
blocks.teachingObjective: This concept motivates the study of ML by highlighting its practical impact and benefits.
examples: Efficiency in decision-making, automation, and prediction

omitted: ML in Real Life: Smart Assistants
